title: Teenage Alberino finds the Book of Enoch at Borders

tellings.quote: I drove to a Borders bookstore and I remember I was perusing

plain: As a teenager, Tim Alberino, a filmmaker who now researches stories of ancient giants, drove to a Borders bookstore, browsed the shelves, and came across the Book of Enoch. That is an ancient Jewish text left out of most Bibles, here in a translation by R. H. Charles and grouped with the Pseudepigrapha, old writings credited to biblical figures. Alberino tells this himself as the moment his interest in these subjects began.
